newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall, export demand low.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall, export demand low.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery fell on Tuesday to 1091/1092 rupees from 1095/1096 on fresh speculative offering and low export demand, dealers said.
Improved new crop arrivals also triggered profit-taking at higher levels, they said.
March delivery was quoted at the steady level of 1140/1145 rupees but trading was nominal. The focus remained on December delivery while March delivery was largely sidelined.
Groundnut oil held steady at the reduced level of 347/348 rupees per 10 kg. In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 530 per 15 kg.
